grh_4dcc75925e30fa20f528.title: Riders On The Storm
paragraphs: Former test pilot Jim Waters has been grounded and emotionally shattered by an earlier accident that cost another man his life. With Dr. Christians encouragement he begins working again and builds a new plane, but his real test comes when a medical emergency on a remote island arises during a violent storm.
